topic: Low IPALamp Breathng Cmd Parameters for Interior Lighting Subsystem
row_semantics: Each row represents a different breathing rate or fade speed setting for the interior lamp, defining how the lamp behaves in terms of periodic flashing and color/亮度切换速度.

core_entities.name: LowIPALampBrthngCmd_1
core_entities.description: Controls the breathing pattern of the interior lamp, determining its periodic flashing behavior.

core_entities.name: LowIPALampFadeSpdCmd_1
core_entities.description: Controls the fade speed of the interior lamp, determining how quickly the lamp changes from one state to another.

core_entities.description: Controls the on/off state of the interior lamp, allowing it to be turned on or off as needed.
